component.name: RoadBoard
component.summary: Virtual audio mixing console for PipeWire

description.p: RoadBoard is a virtual audio mixer: 3 hardware inputs, 2 virtual inputs, 5 multichannel buses (A1 A2 A3 to devices, B1 B2 as virtual microphones), RoadPan voice effects, compressor, gate, limiters, karaoke, 6x8 parametric EQ, integrated recorder, RoadLink network audio, MIDI mapping and programmable macro buttons.
